lines.en: This whole path is my roots.

lines.zh: 我的影子比我先到空地。
lines.en: My shadow reaches the clearing before I do.
I lift a root and bring up a clod of earth.
My roots feel for the path in the soil.
Walk slowly; don't crush the mushrooms.
One step of root and the soil aches.
I take a step, and the forest makes room.
Each step of mine shakes the ground.
My crown brushes the branches, rustling.
I shift toward the light.
Dead leaves break apart under my roots.
The forest is loud today.
This grove is quiet in just the right way.
Under my bark, something gnaws.
The leaves dream very slowly.

lines.zh: 我在听木头里的虫说话。
lines.en: I listen to the worms talking inside my wood.

lines.zh: 我的树叶能拨开，也能挡人。
lines.en: My leaves can be parted, or block your way.

lines.zh: 花叶落下来，我接在枝上。
lines.en: A leaf falls; I catch it on a branch.

lines.zh: 森林里，我在数自己的年轮。
lines.en: In the forest, I count my rings.
Mycelium spreads around my feet.

lines.zh: 脚边的蘑菇又冒出来了。
lines.en: Mushrooms are sprouting at my feet again.

lines.zh: 一只松鼠在我肩上磨牙。
lines.en: A squirrel gnaws its teeth on my shoulder.

lines.zh: 我的树冠接住了一只鸟。
lines.en: My crown caught a bird.

lines.zh: 阳光从叶缝里漏成碎金。
lines.en: Sunlight leaks through my leaves in pieces of gold.
My shadow grew a little.

lines.zh: 我的影子替蚂蚁遮了阴。
lines.en: My shadow gives the ants shade.

lines.zh: 我把根又往下扎了一尺。
lines.en: I sank my roots another foot.
My sap runs slower than yesterday.
The wind turns my leaves like pages.

lines.zh: 一百八十点生命，全在木头里。
lines.en: A hundred eighty health, all in the wood.

lines.zh: 你站得笔直，却没有年轮。
lines.en: You stand straight, but have no growth rings.

lines.zh: 这片林子的落叶，归我扫。
lines.en: The fallen leaves here are mine to sweep.

lines.zh: 我在数你身上有几片叶子。
lines.en: I am counting the leaves stuck to you.
So you're the one Tree Ent mentioned.
Your axe flashed once.

lines.zh: 陌生的气味，从你袖口来。
lines.en: A strange smell comes from your sleeve.
Your soles carry foreign mud.

lines.zh: 树精的眼睛，在树皮下面。
lines.en: An ent's eyes sit under the bark.

lines.zh: 一百八十点血，都是我自己的木头。
lines.en: A hundred eighty health, all my own wood.

lines.zh: 树叶一抖，我就能看见你。
lines.en: One leaf-shake and I see you.

lines.zh: 你靴底带着我刚翻过的土。
lines.en: Your soles carry the soil I just turned.
Look up; my face is in the crown.

lines.zh: 汁液流出来了，我记住了。
lines.en: My sap is running — I will remember this.
The axe bit too shallow to reach my heartwood.
The sap from the cut is sweet.
I want to bury myself again.
Wood chips flew everywhere.
The pain travels slowly along my grain.
Don't hammer my knots with that axe.
A few of my roots have been cut.
Another layer of my bark is gone.
I shuddered, and the forest shuddered.

lines.zh: 甜的东西，我闻着就走不动。
lines.en: Sweet things stop me in my tracks.
I know the smell of bonemeal.

lines.zh: 叶子上的露水，分我一口。
lines.en: Share a sip of the dew on those leaves.

lines.zh: 森林的根，从我脚下伸出去。
lines.en: Forest roots run out from my feet.

lines.zh: 你袋子里的种子，我闻到了。
lines.en: I smell the seeds in your bag.
Pour the soil by my roots.

lines.zh: 蘑菇的伞盖朝我这边歪。
lines.en: The mushroom caps lean toward me.
That leaf is within my reach.
That bucket of water, is it for me?
The seeds in your bag rustle.

lines.zh: 我身上这层苔，长了几十年。
lines.en: This moss took decades to grow.

lines.zh: 叶子挡着我，我一推就开。
lines.en: Leaves block me; one push and they part.

lines.zh: 我这身树皮，比你想的硬。
lines.en: My bark is harder than you think.
You knocked my flowers off.
Steady yourself; the forest waits for no one.
You pressed my tree shadow into the dirt.
Step aside; my roots can't brake.
Your shoulder struck my growth rings.

lines.zh: 你撞落的苔，粘在我脚上。
lines.en: The moss you knocked loose sticks to my foot.
My branches brush your shoulder.
I lower a branch for you.
This spring, I bloom only for you.
My blooming is brief; don't miss it.
Your rings match mine.
Our roots will tangle together.

lines.zh: 我的树皮在春天会裂开，那是新芽。
lines.en: My bark splits in spring — those are new shoots.

lines.zh: 我们的花粉在风里碰上了。
lines.en: Our pollen met in the wind.
Moss has set on my branches.
Our roots held hands underground first.

lines.zh: 靠过来，让我闻你的树皮。
lines.en: Come closer; let me smell your bark.

lines.zh: 这块骨头，埋进树根当肥料。
lines.en: This bone will fertilize my roots.
This resin goes into my hollow.
I bury it in the moss.

lines.zh: 这块木头，我想种在向阳处。
lines.en: I would plant this timber in the sun.
I roll it up, slowly.
Fallen fruit belongs to the soil.
I know this dead branch.

lines.zh: 落叶下面，我埋了点东西。
lines.en: Under the leaf litter I buried something.

lines.zh: 石子压在我的根下正好。
lines.en: A pebble sits nicely under my root.

lines.zh: 这块石头，圆得刚好做根枕。
lines.en: This stone is round enough for a root pillow.

lines.zh: 我的树皮上，刻着旧名字。
lines.en: Old names are carved in my bark.

lines.zh: 我的根，扎在这片林子里。
lines.en: My roots are set in this forest.

lines.zh: 锯末味从你袖口飘出来。
lines.en: The smell of sawdust drifts from your sleeve.

lines.zh: 断枝的脆响，传到我根里。
lines.en: The snap of the branch reached my roots.

lines.zh: 我的根，已经伸到你脚下。
lines.en: My roots are already under your feet.
Little bug, today it is you.

lines.zh: 我的根记下了你的重量。
lines.en: My roots recorded your weight.
Run; my roots get there first.

lines.zh: 一百八十点血，树皮很厚。
lines.en: A hundred eighty hit points and thick bark.

lines.zh: 这一片落叶，都归我看管。
lines.en: Every fallen leaf here is mine to watch.
One push of the leaves and there I stand.
I lay fallen leaves ahead of you.

lines.zh: 树叶一让，我的路就开了。
lines.en: The leaves part and my road opens.

lines.zh: 树叶一动，我就知道你来了。
lines.en: When the leaves stir, I know you're here.
My rootlets are gathering under your feet.

lines.zh: 你数不清这片林子的树。
lines.en: You can't count the trees in this grove.

lines.zh: 你每踩一步，土就告诉我。
lines.en: Every step you take, the soil tells me.

lines.zh: 我的枝条在你头顶合拢。
lines.en: My branches close above your head.
The tree-shade moves faster than you.
Stop circling; the forest is round.
This blow is for the trees that fell.

lines.zh: 树皮账本上记着你那一斧。
lines.en: My bark ledger notes that axe of yours.
Falling timber never apologizes.
I sweep you out of this grove.
Don't stand inside my branch's shadow.
One turn of my rings and you retreat.
The branch lashes down and the wind breaks with it.
The leaves part and out I come.

lines.zh: 我的根从你脚底顶起来。
lines.en: My root heaves up under your feet.

lines.zh: 我的根从土里拔出来，很慢。
lines.en: Pulling my roots up is slow work.
I stand a notch taller than last year.
My head pushes up through the fallen leaves.

lines.zh: 谁在我的林子里生了火？
lines.en: Who lit a fire in my grove?
In the morning mist, I straighten slowly.
This slope was mine once.
A rain woke me.
I count my rings. Another year.
The soil loosened; time to rise.

lines.zh: 我从树根里站起来，土还在掉。
lines.en: I stand from the roots, soil still falling.

lines.zh: 我的根下，压着几块石头。
lines.en: A few stones are pressed under my roots.
The roots woke first, then me.
I push the leaves aside and stand.

lines.zh: 我的叶子在火里卷起来。
lines.en: My leaves curl in the fire.
The branch snapped. That really hurts.
Wood should not float like this.
The crater is full of my broken roots.
The arrow is stuck in my rings.
The spell turns my rings backward.

lines.zh: 土里没养料，我的叶子黄了。
lines.en: No nutrients in the soil; my leaves are yellowing.

lines.zh: 雷把我的树冠削去半边。
lines.en: The lightning sheared half my crown away.
My roots claw at nothing.
